column1: # Game profile of MLB The Show 26 (Switch, update 1.0.19 = v1245184)
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# San Diego Studio's own engine, SDK 19.3.11, NVN. Modules main and sdk only.
# The shaders are GLSLC outputs in the .fxbnvn files under NSW/SHADERS (an FXB\0 wrapper, uncompressed), read by shader_split.py's loose-file GLSLC path.
# Status: provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py from the survey); packed on a PC; first boot on an AYN Thor stopped in nninitStartup (fixed by mem_used); memory values not measured yet
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)

# main sizes its heap as pool − used memory (0xc9400000 = pool − 64 MB); its rewritten modules take 0x5a00000 (90 MB), more than the default 64 MB, so that SetHeapSize failed (ResultLimitReached), nninitStartup aborted with 0x1003 at main+0x5b1b60 (first boot on an AYN Thor, both drivers). 96 MB covers the modules, as Catherine: Full Body's: docs/reference/memory.md#heap-sized-from-the-application-pool-less-used-memory
# Generated faces (create-a-player, every generated player) sample a 16x16 B10G11R11 irradiance cube (flags 0) whose storage is empty at nvnTextureInitialize and that no GPU
# pass, copy or flush ever fills: the CPU writes it later, and as a zero image it stayed 0. The face shader divides by the cube's luma, so 0/0 rendered the faces black.
# tex_dirty_upload uploads a registered texture whose pages the CPU wrote after creating it (DM_VK_ZEROLOG, DM_VK_TEX_STATS on cae2f651a34a6bce, 0.2.22)
